answers.core: Big fan of write-once, run anywhere. Assuming Godot already does this, I don't see any reason to write it again. An add-on could also become visually out of sync with each new version of the engine.
answers.workaround: Yes, I can try and mimic Godot's lights. If this proposal is not accepted, a workaround could be to provide a more accurate design with the light pass documentation.

title: Add a way to skip a specific light in the 3D shader `light()` pass
